{"metadata":{"description":"RikkaHub fork，Android AI 客户端。支持 IM（类 Grok-Bot）模式，ChatGPT 订阅登录使用、跨应用划词悬浮翻译、高性能低延迟远程云电脑控制。","id":"gh:1335852814","install_available":false,"language":"Kotlin","name":"Miffan","slug":"Ayuilos/Miffan","topics":["android","chatbot","cloud-computer","dsh-plugin","gemini","grok-bot","jetpack-compose","kotlin","llm","local-first","material-design-3","mcp","openai","personal-assistant","remote-control","remote-work","rikkahub"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"RikkaHub fork，Android AI 客户端。支持 IM（类 Grok-Bot）模式，ChatGPT 订阅登录使用、跨应用划词悬浮翻译、高性能低延迟远程云电脑控制。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"Miffan
An Android AI app you talk to like a friend, with partners that team up and can work on your "},{"id":"p2s2","text":" Android AI app you talk to like a friend, with partners that team up and can work on your computer."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Bring the AI service you already use, whether that's an API key for an OpenAI-compatible, Gemini or "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"Claude service, a ChatGPT subscription through Codex sign-in, an OpenRouter account, or a Magpie gat"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"eway on your own computer. Miffan doesn't bundle a model. Your chats and settings stay on your phone"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"way on your own computer. Miffan doesn't bundle a model. Your chats and settings stay on your phone."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Chat like a messenger"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Each AI partner is one ongoing chat. There's nothing to start and nothing you have to tune."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **One partner, one conversation.** Your history with a partner reads as one timeline across days. "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"Behind the scenes Miffan keeps topics apart, so long chats stay quick and on point. A divider shows "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"where a new topic began, and one tap continues the last topic instead.
- **Ask several things at onc"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"e.** Unrelated questions run in parallel, and each reply quotes the message it answers.
- **Quick an"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"swers or careful ones.** On a partner's page, choose how long it thinks before replying, from instan"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"t to thinking deeply. For one hard question, pick "Think hard this time" in the + menu.
- **Abilitie"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"s when they're needed.** When a partner needs your calendar, clipboard or screen time, it asks in th"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"e chat and carries on once you allow it.
- **Change a partner by telling it.** "Keep your answers sh"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"orter" adjusts its preferences. With your approval a partner can also change its own name, avatar an"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"d instructions. Every change is linked to the message behind it, kept in a history and can be undone"},{"id":"p7s11","text":".
- **See what AI knows about you.** Each memory shows where it came from, and you can delete it at "},{"id":"p7s12","text":"any time.
- **Ask for a picture.** Pick a drawing model once and any partner can draw, or edit its l"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"ast picture when you say "change it to…".
- **Keep what matters.** Long-press a message to save it. "},{"id":"p7s14","text":"The Discover tab gathers your saved messages and recent drawings, and lets you draw or translate wit"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"hout picking a partner."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Long chats stay one timeline
See what it remembers
The Discover tab"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Partners that work together"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Partners can message each other, and you can bring several into one chat."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Group chats.** A host partner splits the work, mentioned partners reply at the same time, and yo"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"u're notified only when someone mentions you.
- **Mention anyone.** Type @ in a chat to bring in ano"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ther partner.
- **Your chat list, your way.** Pin partners, sort them into groups, and see at a glan"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ce who's working (green) or waiting for your approval (blinking amber).
- **Kept apart.** A partner "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"only recalls chats it took part in, and first contact between two partners needs your OK."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Let your partner use your computer"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Connect a Mac, Windows or Linux computer over SSH, including over Tailscale or, when you're out, thr"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ough Miffan's free relay, and your partner can open apps, type and click on it while you watch from "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"your phone. A server or NAS without a screen works too: the partner uses it through commands."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **One shared screen.** View and control the desktop from your phone, in portrait or full-screen la"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ndscape. While the partner works, the first touch only asks; a second touch takes over. On a Mac or "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"Linux computer you can also show just one window, sized to fit your phone.
- **High-performance mode"},{"id":"p14s4","text":".** With Sunshine on the computer, the graphics card encodes the picture for lower latency, smoother"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" motion and sound. Miffan sets it up and pairs for you.
- **You stay in charge.** Choose per compute"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"r whether the partner asks first, works on its own or leaves it alone. Each approval is recorded in "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"a permission history that stays even if you delete the chat.
- **Tasks that run on schedule.** Ask a"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" partner to do something every morning and the computer's own scheduler runs it on time, even while "},{"id":"p14s9","text":"your phone is off (Mac and Linux). A task can be a command or a call to an AI tool already installed"},{"id":"p14s10","text":" there, such as Claude Code, Codex CLI or Gemini CLI. Results come back to the chat when you open Mi"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ffan, and "My computers" keeps the output of every run.
- **See how a computer is doing.** A status "},{"id":"p14s12","text":"page says in one line whether the computer is ready, fixes problems in place and offers updates for "},{"id":"p14s13","text":"the control helper.
- **A mini box of its own.** Rather keep a partner off your desktop? Give it its"},{"id":"p14s14","text":" own separate mini box on your Mac, Windows or Linux computer. It works freely there and hands finis"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"hed files to a folder on your computer.
- **Easy to connect.** Easy chat finds computers on your Wi-"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"Fi and on Tailscale. Sign in once with the account password and Miffan switches to its own key; Wind"},{"id":"p14s17","text":"ows gets a one-step setup script.
- **Away from home too.** When you're not on the computer's networ"},{"id":"p14s18","text":"k, partners reach it through Miffan's free relay, with no Tailscale needed. You can also use a relay"},{"id":"p14s19","text":"t through Miffan's free relay, with no Tailscale needed. You can also use a relay you host yourself."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Watch it work
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Approve with a tap"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"When a partner wants to do something that matters, such as running a command, scheduling a task, add"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ing a calendar event or calling an MCP tool, it asks with a card you can read: one sentence on what "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"it wants to do and the key details, with the raw call one tap away."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- Allow several ordinary requests at once, or always allow a kind of action and take that back later"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" in the permission history.
- Adjust a calendar event's time before it's added.
- When a partner has"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" a question, tap an option or write your own answer.
- Open any finished change to see exactly what "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"it did, then undo or redo just that change."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Professional mode when you want every option"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Switch to the professional interface at any time. It uses the same data as easy chat."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Combine official APIs, compatible gateways, self-hosted endpoints and a Codex subscription.
- Give"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" each assistant its own prompts, model parameters, memory, MCP servers, Skills and web search.
- Run"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" a local Linux workspace on the phone, or let assistants work on remote servers over SSH with files "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"and a terminal.
- Use voice input and output, translate selected text in any app, and chat from a br"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"owser on your network."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The feature matrix lists every supported provider, search service, speech engine and tool."}],"truncated":true}
